title.narrative: CAFOD & EC Funded Unlocking the Potential of the Moringa Cake Project - Caritas Makeni and Kenema.

description.narrative: This proposal directly addresses the long term improvement of food security of Sierra Leone through the development of small scale livestock and inland fisheries sustainable production schemes. The action will use innovative and locally appropriate approaches and technologies to improve food and income security of vulnerable populations, especially women and youth affected by conflict in Sierra Leone; thereby contributing to the realisation of MDG 1 (i.e. Eradicate Extreme Poverty and Hunger). This will be achieved through developing capacities of local partners and selected communities in Bombali and Kenema districts to enable them pilot innovative, cost effective and locally appropriate initiatives that are locally owned and driven in the production, value addition, consumption and marketing of organic fresh water fish and poultry.
